scope.physics: Independent native FREE recurrence from saved first-FREE pose, actions and exact tapes.
scope.recurrent: First-FREE actor/value readout independently recomputed; every recorded training logit/value replay error checked. Full CNN/LSTM histories not independently rerun.
scope.initial_state: Zero initial h/c follows the hash-locked collector and its tests; no pre-first-input state is archived. Initial pa/pr, no midtrial reset and zero state-noise arrays checked directly.
scope.rgb: Pure native raycast at every active saved pose/layout. Every frame must have >=50% unambiguous pixels. Discontinuous boundary pixels remain exactly archived/hash checked but are excluded from cross-device numerical equality.
scope.summary: Success denominator always includes all 256 trials. Producer path/progress/entropy means also use all rows, assigning zero to invalid missing values; invalid counts are reported explicitly.

totals.descriptive_mean_convention: Means use all prescribed rows; invalid trials contribute zero. Invalid/valid counts are explicit; invalid trials remain failures.
